events.title: The European Court of Human Rights Grand Chamber delivers its rulings in A.R. and Others v. Poland, H.M.M. and Others v. Latvia, and C.O.C.G. and Others v. Lithuania concerning migrant pushbacks at the Belarusian border.
The European Commission is scheduled to publish its legislative proposal for an EU Quantum Act aimed at strengthening European technological sovereignty and competitiveness.
The European Parliament holds a plenary debate in Strasbourg on the restoration of the rule of law and fundamental EU values in Hungary following the 2026 parliamentary elections.
The 37th plenary session of the Czech Chamber of Deputies convenes in Prague, with agenda items including amendments to the Criminal Code, supplementary pension savings, and sports funding.
Czech President Petr Pavel, Defence Minister Jaromír Zůna, and Chief of the General Staff Miroslav Hlaváč address the annual Command Assembly of the Czech Armed Forces in Prague.

Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babiš, Health Minister Adam Vojtěch, and Labour Minister Aleš Juchelka launch a joint pilot project integrating social work into outpatient hospital care at a government conference in Prague.
The US Federal Reserve Board issues its annual benchmark revision to the industrial production and capacity utilization indexes (G.17), rebasing the series to 2022.
The People's Bank of China conducts a tender via the Hong Kong Monetary Authority's CMU platform to issue the 10th and 11th tranches of 2026 central bank bills.
Vietnam observes its newly instituted public holiday, Vietnam Culture Day, granting workers and civil servants a paid day off across the country under National Assembly Resolution 28/2026/QH16.
The Czech Statistical Office (ČSÚ) publishes the November 2026 Business Cycle Survey detailing consumer, business, and overall economic confidence indicators.
The Czech Statistical Office (ČSÚ) releases its annual analysis and open dataset on the use of information and communication technologies (ICT) in households and by individuals for 2026.

The Czech Constitutional Court (IV. Senate, Judge Rapporteur Josef Baxa) publicly pronounces its judgment in a constitutional complaint filed by ČEZ Distribuce concerning renewable energy support contributions.

The Czech Constitutional Court (III. Senate, Judge Rapporteur Daniela Zemanová) publicly delivers its ruling on a constitutional complaint brought by Czech Radio (Český rozhlas) regarding the right to judicial protection.
The parliamentary commission of inquiry investigating corruption in the Prague Public Transit Company, Central Bohemian road management, and VZP ('Operation Dozimetr') holds its 7th session.
The Budget Committee of the Czech Chamber of Deputies convenes for its 27th session.
Czech National Bank (ČNB) board members Jakub Seidler and Jan Procházka debate monetary decision-making amid supply shocks and retail investing at the ČNB Discussion Forum in Karviná.
The Czech Ministry of the Interior hosts an expert roundtable in Prague on crisis communication and media reporting during severe violent incidents.
The European Parliament holds a plenary debate on the Türkiye–Libya Memorandum of Understanding and infringements of the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea.
Dutch trade unions FNV and CNV stage the second day of a nationwide regional public transport strike, halting regional buses and trains across the Netherlands.
NATO Deputy Secretary General Radmila Shekerinska delivers a keynote address at the NATO Resilience Symposium 2026 in Rome.
Dell Technologies reports its quarterly financial results after the close of US markets, serving as a bellwether for enterprise AI server demand.
The Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago publishes its advance November 2026 Labor Market Indicators ahead of the federal employment report.
The UN Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) concludes the 79th executive session of the Trade and Development Board at the Palais des Nations in Geneva.
The 15th United Nations Forum on Business and Human Rights holds its second day of sessions in Geneva.
The OECD, African Union Commission, and African Tax Administration Forum release the Revenue Statistics in Africa 2026 report.
Germany's Federal Statistical Office (Destatis) releases 2026 data on the adoption of artificial intelligence in German enterprises alongside price indices for IT and electrical goods.

France's National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (INSEE) publishes the Q3 2026 Notaires-INSEE price index for existing dwellings and October 2026 imported energy and raw materials price data.
The UK House of Commons Housing, Communities and Local Government Committee holds an oral evidence session on political donations with the Chief Executive of the Electoral Commission.
The Court of Justice of the European Union holds an oral hearing in Case C-686/25 (Madynou), a preliminary ruling reference from Greece.
Following an interim order by the Supreme Court of India in a property and religious rights dispute, authorities conduct a one-time ceremonial lamp lighting at Deepathoon on Thiruparankundram Hill.
EU Regulation 2026/2473 amending fishing provisions in the General Fisheries Commission for the Mediterranean (GFCM) Agreement area enters into force.
Ad-hoc media accreditation closes for the December 2026 Meeting of NATO Ministers of Foreign Affairs at NATO Headquarters in Brussels.
European Court of Human Rights delivers three Grand Chamber rulings on alleged migrant pushbacks by Poland, Latvia and Lithuania at their borders with Belarus.
European Parliament debates restoring the rule of law in Hungary after its 2026 parliamentary elections.
Czech Constitutional Court delivers its ruling on Czech Radio's complaint concerning the right to judicial protection.
European Parliament is scheduled to vote on ending the cancellation of allowances held in the EU Emissions Trading System's market stability reserve.
French Senate continues scrutiny of the 2027 budget after taking up the cross-party agreement on the 2026 year-end finance bill.
Czech Statistical Office releases November business and consumer confidence figures.
Nigeria's central bank concludes its two-day monetary policy meeting, with a rate decision expected.
Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babiš opens a government conference on a pilot to integrate social work into outpatient care at selected hospitals.
French National Assembly votes on a bill to boost housing supply and devolve housing powers.
European Parliament debates the European Semester autumn package, the EU's economic and fiscal policy review.
Czech Constitutional Court rules on ČEZ Distribuce's complaint in a dispute over the 2013 levy supporting renewable energy.
The Conference Board releases its November U.S. consumer confidence survey.
Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem speaks in Toronto on the economic outlook and monetary policy, then takes questions from reporters.
Eurostat publishes its third-quarter overview of EU goods trade and separate updates on trade with the United States and China.
U.S. Federal Reserve publishes its annual revisions to industrial production and capacity utilization, rebasing the indexes to 2022.
Czech Senate's Foreign Affairs, Defence and Security Committee meets behind closed doors and holds a press briefing afterward.
North Carolina's State Board of Elections meets in Raleigh to canvass the November 3 U.S. general election results.
Mexico's statistics agency INEGI releases inflation figures for the first half of November.
France's national congress of mayors opens in Paris, with European Council President António Costa scheduled to address the opening session.
Czech National Bank board members Jakub Seidler and Jan Procházka speak at a public forum in Karviná on supply shocks and retail investing.
Dell Technologies reports fiscal third-quarter results and holds its earnings call.
U.S. Federal Housing Finance Agency releases its third-quarter house price index, including September data.
UN-Habitat's Executive Board opens a two-day session in Nairobi to consider its 2027 work programme and budget.
Czech Statistical Office publishes its 2026 survey on the use of information and communication technology by households and individuals.
Prague 5 resumes its inaugural post-election council meeting after adjourning following the swearing-in of councillors.
Medtronic releases fiscal second-quarter results.
Czech Statistical Office briefs reporters in České Budějovice on South Bohemia's demographic, economic and environmental trends.
Staff at London's Guy's and St Thomas' Foundation health charity begin a three-day strike.
European Parliament in Strasbourg debates the rule of law in Hungary after the 2026 elections and votes on the ETS market-stability reserve, Omnibus IV and the 2027 EU budget conciliation text
Czech Chamber of Deputies opens its 37th sitting, with the 2027 state-budget second reading fixed for the next day
German Bundestag holds the second reading of the 2027 federal budget, starting with the finance ministry and Federal Audit Office
Slovak parliament holds an extraordinary sitting on a no-confidence motion against Foreign Minister Juraj Blanár
European Commission college meets in Strasbourg on a Quantum Act, the European Semester autumn package and the 10th cohesion report
Czech Constitutional Court publicly announces findings, including a dispute over 2013 renewable-energy support contributions
North Carolina State Board of Elections meets to canvass and certify statewide 2026 midterm results
Prime Minister Andrej Babiš opens a government conference on linking health and social care, with the health and labour ministers
ifo Institute publishes the November business-climate index for Germany
ECB releases euro money-market statistics and monthly indicators on government debt securities
President Petr Pavel receives the leadership of the Union of Towns and Municipalities at Prague Castle
UK House of Commons considers Lords amendments to the Armed Forces Bill and the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill
Czech budget committee meets on an income-tax amendment
Dozimetr investigative commission of the Czech Chamber of Deputies meets in closed session
ECB Vice-President Boris Vujčić addresses the OeNB–NBP Conference on European Economic Integration in Vienna
Slovak parliament opens an extraordinary sitting on bills already through first reading, including a proposal to abolish the transaction tax
Czech Statistical Office publishes November business and consumer confidence surveys
UK House of Lords continues committee stage of the Representation of the People Bill
Canadian House of Commons sits, with finance and government-operations committees meeting on used-goods tax treatment and a Buy Canadian policy
Czech Statistical Office publishes 2026 data on ICT use in households and by individuals
UK Office for National Statistics releases the household satellite account for 2024, with provisional 2025 estimates
Czech Statistical Office holds a press conference on South Bohemia in the statistics
EU Publications Office opens the TED-together conference on digital public-procurement data in Luxembourg
